data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 咖啡先放一边
data.description: 她刚坐下就发现咖啡太烫，只好先翻开报纸。看到熟悉的名字，菲亚梅塔皱了下眉，又继续往下读。
data.promptProse: Seated at a small, bistro-style cafe table during a breezy morning, Fiammetta sets aside her steaming cup of coffee to focus intently on a spread-out newspaper. Bright morning sunlight streams through the window, catching the glossy pages of the paper, the steam rising from her coffee, and the rustic charm of the quiet street-side café background.
data.animaCaption: Seated at a small bistro cafe table, she sets her steaming coffee cup aside and holds an open newspaper with a focused, pensive expression. Bright morning sunlight streams through the window, catching rising steam and crisp pages.
